steps.en: Install with uv and put the TypeSafe and text-model keys in .env
steps.zh: 用 uv 装好，把 TypeSafe 和文本模型的 key 写进 .env

steps.en: Point the agent at a start URL and give it one natural-language goal
steps.zh: 给它一个起始网址和一句自然语言目标

steps.en: Reads the visible page into a numbered table of controls and values
steps.zh: 把可见控件和取值读成一张带编号的表

steps.en: One TypeSafe request returns the operation and its element
steps.zh: 一次 TypeSafe 请求拿回操作和对应元素

steps.en: Performs the action on your real Chrome tab
steps.zh: 在你真实的 Chrome 标签页上执行该操作

steps.en: Only for typing, a small LLM writes the string first
steps.zh: 只有打字时才让一个小模型先生成文本

steps.en: Repeats on the new page until it chooses DONE
steps.zh: 在新页面上重复，直到它选择 DONE

value.en: You stop writing per-site selectors and per-step prompts — one goal in, the loop picks the next operation and element
value.zh: 你不用再写站点专用选择器和每步提示词——一句目标进去，循环自己挑下一步操作和元素

sources: https://github.com/browser-use/jev-ultrafast README Try it (uv sync; cp .env.example .env; uv run jev; TYPESAFE_API_KEY and TEXT_MODEL_API_KEY)
README Use the library (from jev_ultrafast import Agent; Agent(url, goal); for state in agent.run())
README Why it moves / the action space (CLICK, TYPE_TEXT, SELECT, SCROLL_UP, SCROLL_DOWN, WAIT, DONE, BLOCKED; one node = one index; one browser call per snapshot)
docs/design.md (one TypeSafe request returns the operation plus per-operation target heads; only TYPE_TEXT calls the text LLM; snapshot.js owns identities and geometry is re-read before input)
